item.title: Herman Miller Aeron vs. Steelcase Leap V2 (2026): 100-Hour Ergonomic & Thermal Comparison
item.description: An ad-free, side-by-side comparison of the Herman Miller Aeron (Size B) and Steelcase Leap V2. Compare seat pressure, mesh vs. foam heat retention, and pricing. Full lab review on ApexWorkflows.

item.title: The 4 Best Ergonomic Office Chairs of 2026: Tested for 8+ Hour Lumbar Support
item.description: We pre-screened 14 office chairs and bench-tested the top 4 finalists over 90 days for lumbar tracking, 4-hour thermal rise, and build durability. Full lab review on ApexWorkflows.

item.title: 5 Best Electric Standing Desks (2026): 220-Lb Load & Wobble Comparison
item.description: We loaded 5 electric sit-stand desks (4 dual-motor + 1 single-motor baseline) with 220 lbs and measured lateral deflection and motor decibels at 46 inches. Full lab review on ApexWorkflows.

item.title: Top 4 Dynamic Microphones for Podcasting & Zoom (2026): Untreated Room Test
item.description: We tested 4 USB/XLR dynamic broadcast microphones in an untreated home office with hardwood floors. See how Shure MV7+, Rode PodMic USB, and ATR2100x compare. Full lab review on ApexWorkflows.

item.title: 4 Best Noise-Cancelling Headphones for Deep Work (2026): Office Chatter & Call Test
item.description: We tested Sony WH-1000XM5, Bose QuietComfort Ultra, Sennheiser Momentum 4, and AirPods Max against office speech and cafe noise. See our 2026 rankings. Full lab review on ApexWorkflows.

item.title: 4 Best 49-Inch Curved Ultrawide Monitors for Coding & Productivity (2026)
item.description: We tested 4 flagship 49-inch 32:9 monitors for macOS/Windows text clarity, subpixel layout, Delta-E color accuracy, and built-in USB-C 90W KVM switches. Full lab review on ApexWorkflows.

item.title: 4 Best Under-Desk Treadmills & Walking Pads (2026): Noise & Compact Folding Test
item.description: We tested 4 under-desk walking pads for motor noise (dBA) during Zoom calls, belt width, and compact storage. Compare WalkingPad C2, UREVO, and DeerRun. Full lab review on ApexWorkflows.

item.title: 4 Best Mechanical Keyboards for Coders & Writers (2026): Switch & Gasket Test

item.title: 4 Best 4K Webcams for Executive Zoom Calls (2026): Low-Light Sensor Test
item.description: We tested 4 flagship 4K webcams for low-light sensor noise, natural optical depth-of-field, and AI gimbal tracking. Compare Insta360 Link 2, OBSBOT, and Elgato. Full lab review on ApexWorkflows.

item.description: We tested 5 ergonomic vertical and sculpted mice across small, medium, and large hand sizes to reduce forearm pronation. Compare Logitech Lift, MX Vertical, and Anker. Full lab review on ApexWorkflows.
